test_title: SSC CHSL Exam 2023 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 10 Jan, 2024 Shift 1).
subject: general
question:
Four of the following five figures are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which is the one that does NOT belong to that group?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6812f022807fe9c4b1b24aefd216edc8092dc981829a884738a2bf74f06de630.png]
solution:
**Logic:** All the give figures except one are squares with one darkened inner triangle and three similar symbols inside. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d46fd2380e0187c1bb60d8991c5f5ae01d82fc704f594106c4712f538923289b.png] 

Figure B is a hexagon with only two symbols inside. 

Therefore, figure B doesn't belong to the group. 

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 1**".
